title: Streamed signed BSGS on P-256 with Montgomery arithmetic and batch affine conversion (standalone exact bound)

claims.statement: For the unrestricted uniform full-production P-256 (secp256r1) target Q=[x]P, the deterministic classical cold attack in proof.md succeeds with probability at least 1/2 using at most 2^(1382191/10000) target-group-operation equivalents under the track's borrowed normalization C=1000. Every P-256 field and point operation is charged through an explicit scalar 64-bit instruction bound (Montgomery multiplication with a written REDC procedure, the a=-3 Jacobian doubling, mixed addition and batch inversion), not through any reference group-operation price. Peak storage is below 2^146 bytes; preprocessing is included in total and bounded by 2^(1382191/10000); nonuniform advice is zero bytes (log convention 0). No heuristic assumptions. This is an analytic construction, not a practical break or executed production attack. The full construction, coverage proof with the P-256 order r, exact total T and ledger are given self-contained in proof.md; the design is credited to submission f888bb9e-1cc3-4be1-bb0a-734722d78885 as provenance only, and no prior acceptance, score or cross-submission comparison is relied upon. The submitted rational bound is justified by the exact integer inequality T^10000 < 1000^10000 * 2^1382191.

experiments.purpose: Bounded stream sorting/intersection, exact coverage, limb-level Montgomery multiplication, a=-3 Jacobian formulas and zero-safe batch normalization on the protected P-256 curve, negative controls and analytic ledger; no production timing inference.
